Hi Samir / Emily —

Thanks again for the call earlier. Per our conversation I attached a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft and pulled out the procurement/vendor-onboarding milestones so your procurement team can see the dependencies and timing. High-level recap and ask:

Milestones (target owner) — proposed dates in parentheses:
- Legal review & SOW sign (Bluepoint legal / Redwood legal) — target: 2026-06-25
- Vendor enrollment in Coupa (Bluepoint procurement) — target: 2026-06-20
- W-9 + vendor banking info submitted (Bluepoint finance) — target: 2026-06-18
- System onboarding & test invoices (Redwood ops / Bluepoint billing) — target: 2026-06-28

Dependencies:
- We need your vendor legal name and W-9 to start Coupa; some marketplaces require exact legal name and EIN.
- If Bluepoint requires a vendor profile in Coupa, we can submit the initial vendor packet but procurement needs to approve the profile.

Immediate asks:
1) Please confirm the preferred target close date for this procurement cycle (you mentioned "end of June" on the call — is 2026-06-30 workable?).
2) Confirm who we should send the W-9 and banking request to (name + email).
3) Let us know whether you want Redwood to initiate the Coupa vendor profile (we'll need the legal name and W-9) or whether you'll open it from your side.

Attachments: [Attachment: MAP-draft-v1.pdf (PDF, 420KB)] — this is the MAP with milestones, owners, and dates.

If you prefer, we can convert the milestones into a shared spreadsheet or link the map to the HubSpot deal.

Thanks — I’ll follow up once I have your procurement POC.
